ctx.x: And so, I tries to tap dance for him. I tried to story tap, you see -- I call it because it's like we are supposed to read some kind of passions in the day's lessons each day, you see, especially on the day of rest, see.

She took me out on Long Island there somewhere, and I had to become -- I got a badge from the revival, see, you know, about Oral Roberts, you see.
